title: Prime Minister shares an article by Union Minister on GeM transforming public procurement
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today shared an insightful article by Union Minister Shri Piyush Goyal detailing the achievements of the Government e Marketplace (GeM) so far. He highlighted transparent procurement, wider participation, and better opportunities, stating that this is how GeM is transforming public procurement.
The Prime Minister noted that with technology at its core, the GeM platform has strengthened Ease of Doing Business over the last 10 years by creating a more competitive and inclusive ecosystem. He observed that it is particularly empowering MSMEs and women entrepreneurs.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"Transparent procurement, wider participation and better opportunities... This is how @GeM_India is transforming public procurement.
With technology at its core, the GeM platform has strengthened Ease of Doing Business over the last 10 years by creating a more competitive and inclusive ecosystem, particularly empowering MSMEs and women entrepreneurs.
Read this insightful article by Union Minister Shri @PiyushGoyal to delve in detail about the achievements so far."

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared an article by Union Minister Piyush Goyal on X highlighting the achievements of the Government e Marketplace (GeM) over the past decade. He praised GeM for enabling transparent procurement, wider participation, and better opportunities, noting it has strengthened Ease of Doing Business by creating a competitive, inclusive ecosystem that particularly empowers MSMEs and women entrepreneurs.
enrichment.context:
The Government e Marketplace (GeM) is an online platform launched in 2016 for procurement of goods and services by government ministries, departments, PSUs, and other public bodies. It was created to replace the earlier fragmented and opaque procurement systems with a transparent, technology-driven marketplace, reducing corruption, delays, and cartelization in public purchases. GeM has since become one of the world's largest public procurement platforms, integrating features like e-bidding, reverse auctions, and direct purchases, and has been credited with significant cost savings for the government.

GeM's design includes special provisions for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and women-led enterprises, such as reservation quotas, relaxed eligibility norms, and startup-specific pathways, aligning with the government's broader push for MSME growth, Make in India, and financial inclusion of small and women entrepreneurs. This aligns with larger governance reforms aimed at improving India's Ease of Doing Business rankings and digital governance (Digital India). The platform is often cited in discussions on e-governance, procurement reform, and inclusive economic growth in the context of India's public administration modernization over the past decade.

prelims_questions.question: The Government e Marketplace (GeM) is primarily associated with which of the following?
options: Online platform for public procurement of goods and services by government bodies
Digital platform for direct benefit transfer of subsidies
Online marketplace for agricultural produce trading
Portal for filing income tax returns
prelims_questions.explanation: GeM is an online platform enabling government ministries, departments, and PSUs to procure goods and services transparently, as described in the release.

prelims_questions.question: Which of the following groups are specifically highlighted as being empowered by the GeM platform, as per the Prime Minister's statement?
prelims_questions.explanation: The release states that GeM is 'particularly empowering MSMEs and women entrepreneurs' by creating a competitive and inclusive ecosystem.
